name: libgen-book-finder
description: Firefox extension that finds a book on the current page and opens a Library Genesis search.

scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename libgen-book-finder.xpi --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json test tools
scripts.lint: web-ext lint --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json test tools
scripts.start: web-ext run --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json test tools
